name: In Favor of Darkness
summary: Dark Cleric Duesten sends you from Deathknell to Brill in In Favor of Darkness. There, you continue your training with Dark Cleric Beryl and study the Holy Light and Shadow.

sections.title: A Path Carved in Rot
sections.body: Dark Cleric Duesten teaches that the Forsaken were forged in corruption and discarded like carrion. Their survival demands that they understand both Light and Shadow without sentimentality. In Tirisfal Glades, you leave Deathknell's graveyard and face the wider world beyond its walls.

sections.title: Instruction in Brill
sections.body: You follow the road northeast from Deathknell, cross a wooden covered bridge, and reach the ruined hamlet of Brill. Dark Cleric Beryl waits in the upper quarters of the local inn to test your resolve. He values ambition and cold practicality over blind devotion, and expects a Forsaken priest to wield divine power as a weapon and a tool, not a moral crutch.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: This rite of passage sends Forsaken priests from Deathknell to continue their training. Dark Cleric Duesten sends you to Dark Cleric Beryl in Brill for your next priestly challenge.

faq.q: Why do Forsaken priests use the Light if they embrace darkness?
aliases: why do undead priests use light
faq.answer: Forsaken clerics study both Light and Shadow because they see the world as governed by their balance. The Holy Light causes excruciating pain to undead flesh, and Forsaken origins lie in rot and darkness, so they study both forces out of practicality and necessity.

faq.q: Where do I find Dark Cleric Beryl?
faq.answer: Dark Cleric Beryl is in Brill, northeast of Deathknell. He resides on the second floor of the Gallows' End Tavern on the settlement's eastern side.

faq.q: What does this quest lead into?
aliases: next quest after in favor of darkness
faq.answer: Speaking with Dark Cleric Beryl completes your training here and opens Garments of Darkness. There, he tests your ability to mend and sustain allies using your newfound disciplines.
Dark Cleric Duesten is the priest trainer in Deathknell. He helps newly awakened Forsaken priests understand their painful existence and use their spiritual powers.

faq.q: Why does Beryl mention ambition over faith?
faq.answer: Forsaken priests view traditional pious faith as insufficient after the powers they worshipped in life abandoned them. Dark Cleric Beryl expects disciples to rely on personal ambition, urgency, and practical strength to survive.

angles.text: As a priest, you learn the Forsaken way: wield both Holy Light and Shadow with cold discretion rather than religious reverence.
As an Undead, you travel from Deathknell to Brill on a standard first excursion into the broader Forsaken realm. The journey shows initiates how their people rebuild in the ruins of Lordaeron.
